remarks: Turnkey quality and exceptional craftsmanship define this beautifully appointed Colonial in the heart of the Silvermine neighborhood-known for its serene setting, natural beauty, and timeless charm-just minutes from New Canaan and Wilton town centers, I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and Route 7. Designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining, the main level offers formal living and dining rooms, a dedicated office or study, and an open-concept living area anchored by a gourmet kitchen with center island, stainless steel appliances, and a sunlit breakfast area. The kitchen flows seamlessly into a spacious family room featuring a dramatic floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace. Upstairs, the serene primary suite includes a walk-in closet and a luxurious spa-like bath, complemented by three additional generously sized bedrooms and a full hall bath. The beautifully finished lower level adds approximately 1,000 square feet of versatile living space-ideal for a playroom, home office, fitness area, or guest retreat. Outdoors, the fully fenced backyard offers a private, family-friendly setting with a dedicated play set and a beautiful pergola ideal for effortless entertaining, al fresco dining, and everyday enjoyment. Additional highlights include a walk-up attic with potential for future expansion, sprinkler system, custom blinds, and professionally landscaped grounds.
